title: Profiler Models
description: Profiler-related models for performance monitoring, frame timing, memory, and span tracing.

ProfilerSample.description: A single profiler sample capturing a point-in-time snapshot of performance metrics.

tsUtc.description: UTC timestamp when this sample was captured.

fps.description: Value produced by a native frame provider. It is authoritative rendered FPS only when frameQuality is 'native.exact'; 'native.cadence' is a display-callback estimate and must not be presented as rendered FPS.

frameTimeMsP50.description: Median interval from the native provider. Interpret as rendered-frame time only when frameQuality is 'native.exact'; 'native.cadence' is display-callback timing.

frameTimeMsP95.description: 95th-percentile interval from the native provider. Interpret as rendered-frame time only when frameQuality is 'native.exact'; 'native.cadence' is display-callback timing.

worstFrameTimeMs.description: Worst interval from the native provider. Interpret as rendered-frame time only when frameQuality is 'native.exact'; 'native.cadence' is display-callback timing.

managedBytes.description: Managed heap memory usage in bytes.

gc0.description: Number of generation 0 garbage collections since last sample.

gc1.description: Number of generation 1 garbage collections since last sample.

gc2.description: Number of generation 2 garbage collections since last sample.

nativeMemoryBytes.description: Native-heap-specific memory usage in bytes. Process resident or physical footprint is reported separately.

nativeMemoryKind.description: Kind of native-heap-specific measurement (for example android.native-heap).

processMemoryBytes.description: Total process resident or physical footprint in bytes. This includes managed pages and must not be interpreted as native heap.

processMemoryKind.description: Kind of process memory measurement (for example process.working-set or apple.phys-footprint).

cpuPercent.description: CPU usage percentage at the time of sampling.

threadCount.description: Total number of threads in the process.

jankFrameCount.description: Number of janky native frames since the last sample. Zero when jank events are unsupported.

uiThreadStallCount.description: Number of native UI thread stalls since the last sample. Zero when stall events are unsupported.

frameDataLossCount.description: Native frame callback records dropped by the platform or the provider's bounded accumulator since the previous sample.

frameSource.description: Source of native frame timing data, or 'unavailable' when no provider supplied a frame sample.

frameQuality.description: Quality of native frame timing data, or 'unavailable' when no provider supplied a frame sample.

ProfilerMarker.description: A discrete profiler marker event representing a notable occurrence.

tsUtc.description: UTC timestamp when this marker was recorded.

name.description: Human-readable name of the marker event.

payloadJson.description: Optional JSON-encoded payload with additional marker data.

ProfilerSpan.description: A profiler span representing a timed operation, compatible with OpenTelemetry span semantics.

parentSpanId.description: Identifier of the parent span, or null for root spans.

startTsUtc.description: UTC timestamp when this span started.

endTsUtc.description: UTC timestamp when this span ended, or null if still in progress.

durationMs.description: Duration of the span in milliseconds.

threadId.description: Identifier of the thread this span executed on.

screen.description: Screen or page name where this span occurred.

elementPath.description: Path to the element in the visual tree associated with this span.

tagsJson.description: Optional JSON-encoded tags with additional span metadata.

error.description: Error message if the span ended with an error.

ProfilerBatch.description: A batch of profiler data including samples, markers, and spans with cursor positions for pagination.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the profiler session this batch belongs to.

samples.description: Array of profiler samples in this batch.

markers.description: Array of profiler markers in this batch.

spans.description: Array of profiler spans in this batch.

sampleCursor.description: Next cursor for samples. It equals the sequence of the last sample returned, not the latest retained sample.

markerCursor.description: Next cursor for markers. It equals the sequence of the last marker returned, not the latest retained marker.

spanCursor.description: Next cursor for spans. It equals the sequence of the last span returned, not the latest retained span.

sampleMetadata.description: Retained range and loss metadata for the sample stream.

markerMetadata.description: Retained range and loss metadata for the marker stream.

spanMetadata.description: Retained range and loss metadata for the span stream.

isActive.description: Whether the profiler session is still actively collecting data.

ProfilerStreamReadMetadata.description: The sequence range retained for one profiler stream. A positive lostCount means the supplied cursor fell behind data overwritten by the bounded buffer.

oldestCursor.description: Oldest sequence currently retained, or 0 when the stream is empty.

latestCursor.description: Latest sequence currently retained, or 0 when the stream is empty.

lostCount.description: Number of items overwritten after the supplied cursor and before oldestCursor.

availableCount.description: Number of retained items available after the supplied cursor before applying the response limit.

ProfilerHotspot.description: A profiler hotspot identifying a frequently occurring or slow operation.

name.description: Name of the operation that is a hotspot.

screen.description: Screen or page where this hotspot occurs.

count.description: Number of times this operation was observed.

errorCount.description: Number of times this operation resulted in an error.

avgDurationMs.description: Average duration of this operation in milliseconds.

ProfilerSessionInfo.description: Information about an active or completed profiler session.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for this profiler session.

startedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the profiler session started.

sampleIntervalMs.description: Interval between profiler samples in milliseconds.

isActive.description: Whether the profiler session is currently active.

ProfilerCapabilities.description: Describes the profiler capabilities available on the current platform and agent.

available.description: Whether profiler endpoints are currently available in this agent.

supportedInBuild.description: Whether profiler support is present in this build.

featureEnabled.description: Whether profiling is enabled by AgentOptions.

managedMemorySupported.description: Whether managed heap memory measurement is supported.

nativeMemorySupported.description: Whether a native-heap-specific memory measurement is supported.

processMemorySupported.description: Whether process resident/physical memory measurement is supported.

gcSupported.description: Whether garbage collection counter reporting is supported.

cpuPercentSupported.description: Whether CPU percentage measurement is supported.

frameTimingsEstimated.description: Whether a native provider supplies cadence estimates rather than exact frame timings. False when frame timing is unavailable.

nativeFrameTimingsSupported.description: Whether native frame timing measurement is supported.

jankEventsSupported.description: Whether jank frame detection events are supported.

uiThreadStallSupported.description: Whether UI thread stall detection is supported.

threadCountSupported.description: Whether thread count reporting is supported.

stopToken.description: Opaque creator capability required to stop this profiler session. It is returned only by start.
